# Test fixtures

Photos used by `integrity_test.ts` to test duplicate-evidence detection. All are free of copyright
restrictions and come from scikit-image's sample data:

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `coffee.jpg` | scikit-image `data.coffee()`, photo by Rachel Michetti | CC0 |
| `chelsea.jpg` | scikit-image `data.chelsea()`, photo by Stefan van der Walt | CC0 |
| `rocket.jpg` | scikit-image `data.rocket()`, SpaceX | Public domain |

Variants (resized, re-encoded, cropped, re-shot) are generated at test time.
